statement.en: forall x y, (forall z, z in x -> z in y) -> (forall z, z in y -> z in x) -> x = y
statement.ja: forall x y, (forall z, z in x -> z in y) -> (forall z, z in y -> z in x) -> x = y

script: theorem my_ext : forall x y, (forall z, z in x -> z in y) -> (forall z, z in y -> z in x) -> x = y.

explanation.en: Here we learn how to use axioms. First, try to proceed with the proof as in the previous lesson.
explanation.ja: ここでは，公理の使用法を学びます．まずは前回と同様に証明を進めてみましょう．

progress.en:
The apply tactic can be used not only with hypotheses, but also with axioms. The extensionality axiom extensionality is available here, so try applying it with

apply extensionality.
progress.ja:
タクティク apply は仮定だけでなく公理に対しても使えます．今回は外延性の公理 extensionality が使えるので，

apply extensionality.

で公理を適用してみましょう．

progress.en: From here, we can complete the proof using the methods we have already learned.
progress.ja: この後は今までの方法で証明できます．
